title: Cube: face rotation as perturber sequence
description:
Define each of the 18 Rubik's Cube moves as a perturber effect.

## Moves
6 faces x 3 rotations = 18 moves:
- U, U'(ccw), U2(180) — Up face
- D, D', D2 — Down face  
- F, F', F2 — Front face
- B, B', B2 — Back face
- L, L', L2 — Left face
- R, R', R2 — Right face

## Anatomy of a single rotation (e.g. U clockwise)
Two cycles happening simultaneously:

### Face cycle (8 stickers on the U face)
Corner cycle: (0,0)→(2,0)→(2,2)→(0,2)→(0,0)
Edge cycle: (1,0)→(2,1)→(1,2)→(0,1)→(1,0)
Center (1,1) stays fixed.

### Edge strip cycle (12 stickers on adjacent faces)
Front row 0: (0,0)(1,0)(2,0) → Right row 0 → Back row 0 (reversed) → Left row 0 → Front row 0

## Perturber representation
Each move is a sequence of cycle effects:
```json
{"sequence": [
  {"cycle": [
    {"zone":"up","pos":"0,0"}, {"zone":"up","pos":"2,0"},
    {"zone":"up","pos":"2,2"}, {"zone":"up","pos":"0,2"}
  ]},
  {"cycle": [
    {"zone":"up","pos":"1,0"}, {"zone":"up","pos":"2,1"},
    {"zone":"up","pos":"1,2"}, {"zone":"up","pos":"0,1"}
  ]},
  {"cycle": [
    {"zone":"front","pos":"0,0"}, {"zone":"right","pos":"0,0"},
    {"zone":"back","pos":"2,0"}, {"zone":"left","pos":"0,0"}
  ]},
  ... (more edge strip cycles)
]}
```

## Counterclockwise
U' is the same cycles but in reverse order (or cycle direction reversed).

## 180 degree
U2 is U applied twice (sequence of the U effect repeated).

## Dependencies
- Requires the cycle perturber primitive (baize-57v)
- All 18 moves must be defined in the game definition rules section

## Test
Apply U to a solved cube, verify exactly the right 20 stickers moved. Apply U 4 times, verify cube returns to solved state.
